# Ranged attack into half cover — SRD 5.2.1

The same template, params and dice as `../ranged-attack-with-cover-srd-5.1/`. Both editions
state half cover as +2 AC (*Playing the Game > Combat > Cover*), so the attack arithmetic is
identical: `15 + 1 (Dexterity) + 2 (proficiency) = 18` against an effective AC of 17, a hit,
for `1d6 4 + 1 = 5` piercing.

The only difference is the target: the `goblin` slug resolves to SRD 5.2.1's Goblin Warrior
with **10** hit points rather than 7, so it ends on 5 rather than 2. The shortbow's Vex
mastery is not encoded by either pack, so no mastery rule fires in this edition either.
